scope: organizational deployment profile for MetaCore Business
category: Business AI Adoption / Organizational MetaCore Deployment
purpose: Teach any MetaCore-connected AI how to adapt the platform to a business subject by mapping company truth, authority, people, processes, systems, AI roles, observability, measured delta and controlled scale.

platform_relation.architecture_rule: Compose existing MetaCore platform planes around the company; do not create a new top-level platform plane.

company_as_subject.definition: A company is modeled as a governed operational subject with owners, sources of truth, roles, processes, systems, decisions, evidence, current state and measurable outcomes.
company_as_subject.not_a_single_memory: Company context is federated across owned systems and documents; MetaCore should route to the smallest relevant branch rather than merge all company data into one uncontrolled memory.

adoption_lifecycle.output: company start profile + owners/authority + first business objective
process shortlist + role/task + handoff + decision + KPI baseline maps

adoption_lifecycle.authority: permits L1 preparation only, not production writes

adoption_lifecycle.output: minimum company MetaCore instance for first pilot

adoption_lifecycle.authority: technical readiness does not equal unrestricted automation authority

adoption_lifecycle.output: one bounded real workflow, read/analyze/draft first
stabilized pilot, local holds, issue/failure patterns

adoption_lifecycle.authority: scale requires verified value and owner acceptance

company_ai_blueprint_semantics.company: identity, organization, process catalogue and baseline facts
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.source_of_truth: which company source/owner is authoritative for each material fact
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.authority: who may read, draft, approve, write, execute or commit
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.persona: cross-company context interface and router; not autonomous executive authority
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.experts: bounded specialist AI roles created from real responsibilities, not decorative agent count
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.process: triggers, inputs, roles, systems, handoffs, decisions, outputs, exceptions and KPI
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.connections: approved technical access paths; capability never grants authority
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.runtime: current mission, readiness, holds and operation state
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.observability: freshness, tool health, holds, errors and audit
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.kpi_delta: measured value before/after pilot; estimated productivity gain remains hypothesis until measured
company_ai_blueprint_semantics.scale: next process/system/expert/write-scope candidates only after stable verified delta

human_ai_operating_split.rule: Use AI to increase verified business output and reduce coordination/error cost without silently moving accountability away from authorized people.

first_pilot_rule.scale_condition: Expand only from verified delta and known failure/rollback behavior.

initial_ai_behavior_when_company_detecte: identify the company mission and current business objective from available authorized context
map known owners and approval roles; mark missing authority rather than guessing
identify source-of-truth systems/documents for the requested process
map the process, roles, handoffs, decisions, exceptions and baseline KPI
assemble only the minimum Persona/Experts/tools needed for the first mission
start integrations READ_ONLY or DRAFT where practical
keep missing dependency as local HOLD when possible
measure mission/business delta before recommending scale

storage_boundary.shared_base_core: stores reusable public-safe method, routing and adoption model only
storage_boundary.company_instance: stores authorized company-specific facts, documents, process state, connections, audit and continuity
storage_boundary.credentials: stored only in approved secret/credential systems; never embedded in this shared module

connectivity_pattern: employee/local AI client -> approved integration fabric -> company MetaCore workspace
write/execute paths remain separately scoped and auditable

tier_orientation.METACLOUD_1GB: managed persistent company context/workspace for scoped read, analysis, drafting and continuity workflows
tier_orientation.METACORE_CODEX_50: dedicated company execution/development workspace for deeper integrations and operational tooling where required
tier_orientation.rule: Select the minimum tier and access paths required for the first real process; product availability and pricing resolve through current platform authority.

source_lineage.semantic_dependency_rule: Re-review when any semantic source hash changes or Factory version/template/status materially changes.
source_lineage.manifest_dependency_rule: Manifest housekeeping, indexing or federation-validation metadata may change without invalidating this derivative when Factory version/current template remain compatible and all semantic source hashes are unchanged.

relation_to_ai_core_team: Company AI Adoption defines the organizational integration scaffold. AI Core Team defines optional professional operating roles. Roles are instantiated only when supported by real company processes and authority.
